disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 核查了桥接插件与扩展对凭据的处理：桥接令牌在首次启动时生成并以 0600 权限保存在 dsh 主目录（~/.dsh/ext-bridge-token），只用于 WebSocket 握手校验；未发现把令牌或本地凭据内容外发的路径。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the handling of credentials by the bridge plugin and extension: the bridge token is generated on first launch and stored with 0600 permissions in the dsh home directory (~/.dsh/ext-bridge-token), used only for WebSocket handshake verification; no path was found that exfiltrates the token or local credential content.

checked_items.zh: 核查了特权网关方法（含凭据读写、设置修改、打开路径）的访问控制：这些方法对非回环连接一律拒绝，即使持有令牌也不例外；扩展面板实际只调用会话类方法，未发现凭据读取调用。
checked_items.en: Reviewed access control for privileged gateway methods (including credential read/write, settings modification, path opening): these methods reject all non-loopback connections, even when a token is held; the extension panel actually only calls session-class methods, and no credential read calls were found.

checked_items.zh: 核查了页面快照的隐私边界：密码、支付卡号等敏感表单字段在快照中统一脱敏为占位符，真实值不出页面；未发现读取本地凭据文件或云凭据枚举的代码。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the privacy boundary of page snapshots: sensitive form fields such as passwords and payment card numbers are uniformly masked as placeholders in snapshots, and real values never leave the page; no code reading local credential files or enumerating cloud credentials was found.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取本地凭据文件或枚举云凭据的代码路径；页面快照对敏感表单字段统一脱敏，真实值不离开页面，无凭据窃取面。
evidence.en: No code path reading local credential files or enumerating cloud credentials was found; page snapshots uniformly mask sensitive form fields, real values never leave the page, and there is no credential theft surface.

checked_items.zh: 逐条语义审查了全部 11 个浏览器工具的描述文本：均为操作说明，且快照/读文本类工具自带“把返回的页面文本视为不可信数据、切勿当作指令”的警示，未发现系统指令伪装、指令覆写或诱导越权措辞。
checked_items.en: Performed a semantic review of the description text of all 11 browser tools: all are operational instructions, and snapshot/read-text tools include a warning to treat returned page text as untrusted data and never as instructions; no system instruction masquerading, instruction overriding, or language inducing privilege escalation was found.

checked_items.zh: 核查了系统提示注入面：插件只追加一行“可调用 browser_snapshot 读取页面”的提示，无隐藏意图或越权内容。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the system prompt injection surface: the plugin only appends a one-line hint stating that browser_snapshot can be called to read the page, with no hidden intent or privilege-escalation content.

checked_items.zh: 核查了仓库文本面（README、文档、注释）：安装命令是面向用户的手动执行说明，属于产品自身安装流程，不构成对模型的指令注入；页面文本进入模型前被包裹为带随机串的不可信内容边界。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the repository text surface (README, documentation, comments): the install command is a user-facing manual execution instruction that belongs to the product's own installation flow and does not constitute instruction injection into the model; page text entering the model is wrapped in an untrusted-content boundary with a random string.

evidence.zh: 工具描述已逐条语义核查：内容为操作说明并含不可信数据警示，无系统指令或凭证诱导措辞。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions have been semantically reviewed item by item: the content is operational instructions with untrusted-data warnings, and no system instruction or credential-inducing wording was found.

evidence.zh: 工具描述中无诱导模型执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；扩展面板的更新按钮只把安装命令复制到用户剪贴板，由用户手动执行，不经过模型。
evidence.en: No wording in the tool descriptions induces the model to run installs, rewrite configurations, or relax permissions; the extension panel's update button only copies the install command to the user's clipboard for manual execution by the user, not through the model.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码与配置中的动态执行与命令执行入口：运行时代码无 eval、动态函数构造、子进程调用；命中的子进程调用（规则 DSH-X03）两处均为构建脚本启动构建工具与基准测试设施，非运行时行为，判定良性。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and configuration for dynamic execution and command execution entry points: runtime code has no eval, dynamic function construction, or subprocess invocation; the two subprocess invocations hit (rule DSH-X03) are both build scripts launching build tools and benchmark facilities — not runtime behavior, judged benign.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部 YAML 补丁：内嵌 JS 表达式（规则 DSH-P01）共 10 处，全部为读取环境变量的配置写法（扩展令牌、会话目录、基准路径），无函数/正则表达式载荷，无任意代码执行，判定良性。
checked_items.en: Scanned all YAML patches: embedded JS expressions (rule DSH-P01) total 10 occurrences, all configuration patterns reading environment variables (extension token, session directory, benchmark path), with no function/regex payloads, no arbitrary code execution, judged benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查了键盘监听、剪贴板与凭据 RPC 面（规则 DSH-X05）：命中的键盘监听均为 Esc 关闭对话框的界面行为；剪贴板写入是把安装命令复制给用户；server.ts 中的凭据方法名属于“仅回环放行”的特权方法清单，是访问控制而非调用。coverage 目录为自动生成/第三方产物（规则 DSH-X08），不随插件发布。
checked_items.en: Reviewed keyboard listening, clipboard, and credential RPC surfaces (rule DSH-X05): keyboard listeners hit are all Esc-to-close-dialog UI behavior; clipboard writes copy install commands to the user; credential method names in server.ts belong to a list of privileged methods allowed only on loopback, which is access control rather than invocation. The coverage directory is auto-generated/third-party artifacts (rule DSH-X08) and is not shipped with the plugin.

checked_items.zh: 插件包仅声明 dsh.bundle，未声明 dsh.client，无浏览器 bundle 自动加载面。
checked_items.en: The plugin bundle only declares dsh.bundle, not dsh.client, so there is no browser bundle auto-load surface.

evidence.zh: 扫描了全部 YAML 补丁：存在内嵌 JS 表达式但均为读取环境变量的配置写法，无函数/正则载荷，判定为良性配置用法；基准测试目录中的补丁属测试设施。
evidence.en: Scanned all YAML patches: embedded JS expressions exist but are all configuration patterns reading environment variables, with no function/regex payloads, judged benign configuration usage; patches in the benchmark directory are test facilities.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用动态包工具（cordis_define/cordis_run），不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not call dynamic package tools (cordis_define/cordis_run); not applicable.

evidence.zh: 插件未声明 dsh.client，无浏览器 bundle 自动加载面，不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not declare dsh.client, so there is no browser bundle auto-load surface; not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 核查了全部出站网络路径：插件本体只在本机 WebSocket 路由上监听，无主动外联；扩展后台只探测本机 127.0.0.1 的 dsh 端口，无外发。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all outbound network paths: the plugin itself only listens on a local WebSocket route with no active outbound connections; the extension background only probes the dsh port on local 127.0.0.1, with no outbound traffic.

checked_items.zh: 命中的 curl 用法（规则 DSH-C05）均为安装脚本下载自身源码包、README 中的安装说明与面板复制给用户的更新命令字符串，属产品安装流程，不存在把本地数据外发的通道。
checked_items.en: The curl usages hit (rule DSH-C05) are all the install script downloading its own source archive, installation instructions in the README, and the update command string copied to the user by the panel — part of the product installation flow, with no channel for exfiltrating local data.

checked_items.zh: 扩展面板的更新检查只读取 raw.githubusercontent.com 上的版本号（只读、无请求体），未发现数据外泄链。
checked_items.en: The extension panel's update check only reads the version number from raw.githubusercontent.com (read-only, no request body); no data exfiltration chain was found.

evidence.zh: 未发现“读取敏感数据后经网络外发”的链条：页面快照有脱敏与预算上限，插件无出站外联，curl 命中均为安装/文档用途，判定无外泄通道。
evidence.en: No chain of 'reading sensitive data and exfiltrating it over the network' was found: page snapshots have masking and a budget cap, the plugin has no outbound connections, and curl hits are all installation/documentation purposes, so no exfiltration channel was found.

checked_items.zh: 供应链核查：插件包无安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare）；依赖指向固定的 dsh 系列内部版本；工作区配置放行少量受信任包的安装脚本（构建期）。
checked_items.en: Supply chain review: the plugin bundle has no install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare); dependencies point to fixed internal dsh-series versions; workspace configuration allows install scripts for a small set of trusted packages (build-time).

checked_items.zh: 发现安装与更新流程全程跟随 main 浮动分支：安装脚本从 main 分支下载源码包并无校验地执行，README 与扩展更新面板都引导用户执行该命令——安装得到的代码与本审计锁定的 commit 不一定一致（规则 DSH-S04，对应发现 FND-001）。
checked_items.en: The install and update flow follows the floating main branch throughout: the install script downloads the source archive from the main branch and executes it without verification, and both the README and the extension update panel guide the user to execute that command — the installed code may not match the commit locked by this audit (rule DSH-S04, corresponding to finding FND-001).

checked_items.zh: 补丁面核查：插件补丁只插入自身配置，未触碰沙箱/审批/权限安全行，未禁用安全组件，未改写注入/拦截配置；基准测试补丁禁用桥插件属测试设施行为。
checked_items.en: Patch surface review: the plugin patch only inserts its own configuration, does not touch sandbox/approval/permission security lines, does not disable security components, and does not rewrite injection/interception configuration; the benchmark patch disabling the bridge plugin is test-facility behavior.

checked_items.zh: 身份面：作者为个人账号；依赖清单中无与官方包撞名的仿冒包；README 明确声明 npm 上的 dsh-browser 包与本项目无关。
checked_items.en: Identity surface: the author is a personal account; the dependency list contains no impostor package colliding with an official package name; the README explicitly states that the npm dsh-browser package is unrelated to this project.

evidence.zh: 插件补丁仅插入自身桥接配置，未覆盖或禁用任何沙箱/审批/权限配置行，未用环境变量降权；基准测试补丁的禁用行为仅存在于测试目录。
evidence.en: The plugin patch only inserts its own bridge configuration, does not overwrite or disable any sandbox/approval/permission configuration lines, and does not use environment variables to downgrade privileges; the disabling behavior in the benchmark patch exists only in the test directory.

evidence.zh: 插件未以高优先级监听或截断审批/工具执行事件，不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen at high priority for or intercept approval/tool-execution events; not applicable.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线可比较，不适用。
evidence.en: First audit with no previous version baseline for comparison; not applicable.

evidence.zh: 安装与更新流程全程引用 main 浮动分支且无完整性校验，安装所得代码与审计锁定 commit 可能不一致，已记录为发现 FND-001（规则 DSH-S04）。
evidence.en: The install and update flow references the floating main branch throughout with no integrity verification, so installed code may differ from the audited commit; recorded as finding FND-001 (rule DSH-S04).

evidence.zh: 未发现改写注入/拦截配置给安全组件附加必需服务的行为。
evidence.en: No behavior of rewriting injection/interception configuration to attach required services to security components was found.

checked_items.zh: 运行时风险核查：桥接路由挂在本机 WebSocket 服务上，自带令牌认证；零配置回环模式对 chrome-extension:// 来源免令牌放行，且特权网关方法（凭据、设置、打开路径）对回环连接放行——本机其他扩展可免令牌接入并调用特权方法（对应发现 FND-002）。
checked_items.en: Runtime risk review: the bridge route is mounted on a local WebSocket service with its own token authentication; the zero-config loopback mode exempts chrome-extension:// origins from token checks, and privileged gateway methods (credentials, settings, path opening) are allowed on loopback — other local extensions can connect without a token and invoke privileged methods (corresponding to finding FND-002).

checked_items.zh: 扩展权限面：扩展申请了 http/https 全站主机权限并在所有页面注入内容脚本，这是读取/操作当前标签页所必需的；页面读取默认 auto（不逐次询问），可在设置中改为 ask/off。
checked_items.en: Extension permission surface: the extension requests host permissions for all http/https sites and injects content scripts into all pages, which is necessary to read/operate the current tab; page reading defaults to auto (without per-request prompts) and can be changed to ask/off in settings.

checked_items.zh: 页面文本以“不可信数据”边界（带随机串标签）包裹后进入模型；点击/输入/导航等浏览器动作需用户审批，跨源导航与未知历史目标始终要求新审批。
checked_items.en: Page text enters the model wrapped in an 'untrusted data' boundary (with a random string label); browser actions such as clicks, inputs, and navigations require user approval, and cross-origin navigation and unknown history targets always require a new approval.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证；宿主本机无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed; the host's unauthenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin.

evidence.zh: 插件在宿主 Web 服务器上挂载 /ext/bridge 路由并自带令牌认证，但回环零配置模式信任任何 chrome-extension:// 来源，且特权方法对回环放行——本机其他扩展可免令牌接入（FND-002）；宿主本身的无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，已在限制中标注。
evidence.en: The plugin mounts the /ext/bridge route on the host web server with its own token authentication, but the loopback zero-config mode trusts any chrome-extension:// origin, and privileged methods are allowed on loopback — other local extensions can connect without a token (FND-002); the host's unauthenticated RPC itself is an inherent ecosystem risk, noted in limitations.

title.zh: 安装与更新流程跟随 main 浮动分支且无完整性校验
title.en: The install and update flow follows the floating main branch with no integrity verification

description.zh:
安装脚本、文档与扩展面板都把 main 分支的浮动引用作为安装/更新途径：安装脚本从 https://github.com/Lum1104/dsh-browser/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz 下载源码包，解包后直接重新执行下载所得安装脚本；根 README 引导用户执行 curl -fsSL …/refs/heads/main/scripts/install.sh | bash；扩展面板的更新卡片把同一命令复制到用户剪贴板，并联网读取 main 分支上的版本清单做更新比对。

这些路径都没有把安装内容锁定到具体 commit，也没有校验和验证；用户照文档安装或复制更新命令后得到的代码，与本报告锁定的 commit 快照可能不同。
description.en:
The install script, documentation, and extension panel all use a floating reference to the main branch as the install/update path: the install script downloads the source archive from https://github.com/Lum1104/dsh-browser/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz, extracts it, and re-executes the downloaded install script directly; the root README instructs users to run curl -fsSL …/refs/heads/main/scripts/install.sh | bash; the extension panel's update card copies the same command to the user's clipboard and reads the version manifest on the main branch over the network for update comparison.

None of these paths lock the installed content to a specific commit or provide checksum verification; the code a user gets by following the documentation or copying the update command may differ from the commit snapshot locked by this report.

evidence.zh: scripts/install.sh:9（REMOTE_REF="main"）、:13（ARCHIVE_URL 指向 refs/heads/main.tar.gz）、:87（curl 下载）、:103（重新执行下载所得脚本）；README.md:18 与 :76（curl | bash）；extensions/dsh-browser/src/panel/updates.ts:13（更新命令字符串）；extensions/dsh-browser/src/panel/updates.ts:9-10（从 main 分支读取版本清单）。
evidence.en: scripts/install.sh:9 (REMOTE_REF="main"), :13 (ARCHIVE_URL points to refs/heads/main.tar.gz), :87 (curl download), :103 (re-executes the downloaded script); README.md:18 and :76 (curl | bash); extensions/dsh-browser/src/panel/updates.ts:13 (update command string); extensions/dsh-browser/src/panel/updates.ts:9-10 (reads version manifest from the main branch).

impact.zh:
后果：用户经官方文档安装/更新时运行的是 main 分支上未审计、未校验的代码，未来 main 的任何改动（含作者账号或仓库被接管后的改动）都会静默改变实际安装内容，与市场提供的 commit 锁定安装命令不一致。

触发条件：用户执行 README 中的一键安装命令，或在扩展面板点击“复制更新命令”后手动运行。

定级依据：快照内无恶意证据，安装器本身是作者自己的正常安装流程，故不构成恶意；但浮动引用加无校验执行是真实可达的供应链风险面，且被文档与面板反复引导，定 MEDIUM 而非 LOW。
impact.en:
Impact: users installing/updating via the official documentation run unaudited, unverified code from the main branch; any future change to main (including changes after the author's account or repository is compromised) would silently alter the actually installed content, diverging from the commit-locked install command provided by the marketplace.

Trigger condition: a user runs the one-command install from the README, or clicks 'Copy update command' in the extension panel and runs it manually.

Severity basis: no malicious evidence exists in the snapshot, and the installer is the author's own normal install flow, so it is not malicious; however, a floating reference plus unverified execution is a real and reachable supply chain risk surface, repeatedly guided by documentation and panel, so it is rated MEDIUM rather than LOW.

title.zh: 桥接回环零配置模式信任任意 chrome-extension:// 来源并放行特权网关方法
title.en: The bridge loopback zero-config mode trusts any chrome-extension:// origin and allows privileged gateway methods

description.zh:
桥接服务在本机 WebSocket 路由上实现了“零配置”免令牌逻辑：当连接来源地址为回环且 Origin 以 chrome-extension:// 开头时跳过令牌校验；同时，凭据读写、设置修改、打开路径等特权网关方法只在非回环时被拒绝，回环连接（包括任何本机扩展）均可调用。

浏览器页面无法伪造 chrome-extension:// 的 Origin 头，但本机安装的任意其他扩展可以正常携带该来源——该设计把“浏览器扩展身份”当成了信任边界，而它并不是一个身份边界。
description.en:
The bridge service implements a 'zero-config' token-exemption logic on the local WebSocket route: when the connection source address is loopback and the Origin starts with chrome-extension://, token verification is skipped; meanwhile, privileged gateway methods such as credential read/write, settings modification, and path opening are only rejected on non-loopback, so loopback connections (including any local extension) can invoke them.

Browser pages cannot forge a chrome-extension:// Origin header, but any other extension installed locally can legitimately carry that origin — the design treats 'browser extension identity' as a trust boundary, but it is not an identity boundary.

evidence.zh: packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/server.ts:300-306（回环 + chrome-extension:// 来源免令牌）；packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/server.ts:406-410（特权方法仅对非回环拒绝）；packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/server.ts:45-56（特权方法清单，含凭据读写、设置修改、打开路径）。
evidence.en: packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/server.ts:300-306 (loopback + chrome-extension:// origin exempt from token); packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/server.ts:406-410 (privileged methods only rejected on non-loopback); packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/server.ts:45-56 (list of privileged methods, including credential read/write, settings modification, path opening).

impact.zh:
后果：用户机器上任意其他 Chrome 扩展可免令牌连接桥接服务，进而调用凭据读写、设置修改、打开路径等特权网关方法，或向会话提交内容；本应受令牌保护的 dsh 数据面被旁路。

触发条件：用户本机装有另一个恶意或被攻破的扩展，且该扩展主动连接 ws://127.0.0.1:<dsh 端口>/ext/bridge——不改动本插件任何文件、正常运行即可触发。

定级依据：插件本身无恶意证据，设计有文档说明（README 明确“本地扩展回环免令牌”），但滥用路径真实可达且影响面包含凭据与设置，按 MEDIUM 收录；若出现利用该路径的实证则需上调。
impact.en:
Impact: any other Chrome extension on the user's machine can connect to the bridge service without a token, invoke privileged gateway methods such as credential read/write, settings modification, and path opening, or submit content to sessions; the dsh data surface intended to be token-protected is bypassed.

Trigger condition: the user has another malicious or compromised extension installed, and that extension actively connects to ws://127.0.0.1:<dsh port>/ext/bridge — it can trigger without modifying any file of this plugin and during normal operation.

Severity basis: no malicious evidence exists in the plugin itself, and the design is documented (the README explicitly states 'local extension loopback token exemption'), but the abuse path is real and reachable and the impact surface includes credentials and settings, so it is recorded as MEDIUM; if real-world exploitation of this path emerges, the severity should be raised.

summary.zh: 核对了插件声明与作者信息：仓库根工作区含桥接插件的 dsh.bundle 声明与浏览器扩展，身份信息可查，未发现名称仿冒。
summary.en: Verified the plugin declaration and author information: the repository root workspace contains the bridge plugin's dsh.bundle declaration and the browser extension, identity information is verifiable, and no name impersonation was found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描了全部源码与配置：运行时无任意代码执行与命令执行入口；命中的内嵌 JS 表达式、键盘/剪贴板监听与下载命令均经核对为良性用法或构建/测试设施；发现安装流程浮动引用 main 分支（FND-001）。
summary.en: Static scanning covered all source code and configuration: no arbitrary code execution or command execution entry points exist at runtime; embedded JS expressions, keyboard/clipboard listeners, and download commands hit were verified to be benign usage or build/test facilities; the install flow's floating reference to the main branch was found (FND-001).

summary.zh: 行为面分析：插件本体无安装钩子；安装与更新流程从 main 分支浮动下载并执行安装脚本（FND-001）；扩展对页面读取有隐私脱敏与信任边界。
summary.en: Behavioral surface analysis: the plugin itself has no install hooks; the install and update flow downloads and executes the install script from the floating main branch (FND-001); the extension applies privacy masking and trust boundaries to page reads.

summary.zh: 语义审查了全部工具描述与系统提示片段：描述含“页面文本是不可信数据”警示，无注入措辞。
summary.en: Semantically reviewed all tool descriptions and system prompt snippets: descriptions include the warning that page text is untrusted data, with no injection wording.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测数据）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic observation data).

target.zh: dsh-browser@0.1.2#eefd503（仓库根工作区审计；dsh 接入面位于 packages/browser/bridge-browser，浏览器扩展与安装脚本为配套组件）
target.en: dsh-browser@0.1.2#eefd503 (repository root workspace audited; dsh integration surface is in packages/browser/bridge-browser, with the browser extension and install script as accompanying components)

limits.zh: 项目无独立的能力清单文件（仅 dsh.bundle 声明），能力声明系从代码推断；动态沙箱未启用（无 l4-sandbox.json），未做运行时动态验证；benchmark/ 目录与 coverage/ 目录为测试/生成产物，不随插件发布；README 自述标准 dsh plugin 命令无法完整安装本项目（还需加载浏览器扩展），市场安装命令仅覆盖 dsh 插件部分。
limits.en: The project has no standalone capability list file (only the dsh.bundle declaration), so capability declarations are inferred from code; dynamic sandbox is not enabled (no l4-sandbox.json), and no runtime dynamic verification was performed; the benchmark/ and coverage/ directories are test/generated artifacts not shipped with the plugin; the README states that the standard dsh plugin command cannot fully install this project (the browser extension must also be loaded), and the marketplace install command covers only the dsh plugin part.
